cards.meaning: was sacked; was removed from post
cards.example: Sinibak ng kalihim ang anim na kawani ng DPWH sa Davao.
cards.exampleMeaning: The secretary sacked six DPWH staff in Davao.
cards.note: Pangkaraniwan sa pamagat ng balita para sa biglaang pagtanggal sa puwesto; mas matigas kaysa 'inalis' at mas madalas sa pamahalaan kaysa sa pribadong kumpanya.
cards.tiesTo: DPWH removes more Davao staff over flood-control anomalies

cards.example: Pondong pampulitika raw ang P37.49 bilyon na inilagay sa badyet.
cards.exampleMeaning: The P37.49 billion placed in the budget is said to be a political fund.
cards.note: Pang-uri na may unlaping 'pam-'; ginagamit sa pormal na balita at madalas may pahiwatig ng pansariling interes kapag kasama ng 'pondo' o 'motibo'.
cards.tiesTo: P37.49B local government fund in the 2027 budget

cards.example: 工业增长了5.5%，尽管如此，零售只增长了1.1%。
cards.examplePinyin: Gōngyè zēngzhǎng le wǔ diǎn wǔ, jǐnguǎn rúcǐ, língshòu zhǐ zēngzhǎng le yī diǎn yī.
cards.exampleMeaning: Industry grew 5.5%; even so, retail grew only 1.1%.
cards.note: 书面语 connective that stands alone as a sentence opener after a concession. Contrast 尽管…还是, which sits inside one sentence; 尽管如此 closes the previous clause and pivots.
cards.tiesTo: China September data: factories at 5.5%, shops at 1.1%

cards.example: 房地产开发投资持续下滑。
cards.note: Neutral-to-formal; typical collocations are 销量下滑, 利润下滑, 投资下滑. Gentler than 暴跌 (plunge) and slower than 下降 suggests nothing about speed; 下滑 implies a worrying trend.
